description: Continuation of the 200 ms-quantized high-level decision-to-actuation latency ladder after the independent 0/200/400 ms quick tier passed. It tests 600 and 800 ms latency only, equivalent to three and four K10 Navigator decision periods.

quick_gate.note: The next decision-latency tier is created only if every frozen quick EpisodeSpec succeeds with no fall or invalid state. A timeout, fall, or invalid state identifies the first failed tier.

full_gate.note: Formal is user-launched only after every quick condition passes. This decision-latency protocol is exploratory and does not replace the 0/20/40 ms command-transport OOD protocol.
